title: Alertmanager：抑制規則的租戶鍵與空值陷阱
titleEn: Alertmanager: tenant keys and missing-label inhibition traps
subcategoryTitle: 偵測評估、遺失診斷與告警治理
subcategoryTitleEn: Detection evaluation, loss diagnosis and alert governance
summary: 用合成警示建立source、target、tenant、cluster四欄真值表，先界定允許被抑制的範圍。
summaryEn: Build source, target, tenant and cluster truth tables for synthetic alerts, defining allowed inhibition scope beforehand.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

optionsEn: Treating missing labels as wildcards crosses tenant boundaries; fewer notifications can hide failed delivery rather than improve operations.

steps.instructionEn:
